discoveries.title: UVZ improves selected test detection and object translation but not train hand error
discoveries.body: On test3 UVZ joint L2 is 83.16 mm vs direct 85.92 mm and F1 is 0.892 vs 0.793; on train3 UVZ joint L2 is worse at 108.00 mm vs direct 89.07 mm.

discoveries.title: Comparison is not GPU-matched
discoveries.body: Direct ran with 8 GPUs; UVZ ran with 4 GPUs after the 8GPU submission hit ACP quota 429. Treat this as a useful contrast, not the final fair ablation.

discoveries.title: Checkpoint serialization contract passed
discoveries.body: Both final checkpoints include all expected trainable prefixes, including direct joint heads and the model-specific gamma head.

discoveries.title: Video render path completed despite remote ffmpeg absence
discoveries.body: Remote generated frames using dataset access and torch; local ffmpeg encoded H.264 mp4 assets, then the videos were synced back to the remote artifact directory.

discoveries.title: Raw L2 hid a much lower PA-MPJPE regime
discoveries.body: Selected evals have raw MPJPE around 83-108 mm, but PA-MPJPE is about 5.67-7.61 mm and root-aligned MPJPE is about 23.9-34.2 mm.

tasks_pending.summary: Optionally rerun UVZ as 8GPU if an exactly GPU-matched fair comparison is required.

caveats: UVZ is quota-limited 4GPU while direct is 8GPU.
